source_kind: derived aggregate over retained final-quarterly NCUA evidence
ownership: NCUA publishes source fields; this publisher owns only the governed aggregate transformation.
allowed_use: bounded source classification and reported-service counts
prohibited_use: publishing names, addresses, phones, hours, charter/site identifiers, ATTENTION_OF, or record identifiers
claiming all credit unions, public access, membership eligibility, current hours, or service availability

attribution: Source: National Credit Union Administration final quarterly Call Report data.
